items.title: CherryTree through 1.7.3 Local File Read via LaTeX Filter Bypass
items.summary: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a LaTeX rendering filter bypass vulnerability in is latex text safe() that allows attackers to read local files by building blocked command names with TeX macro expansion. Attackers can craft a document with a LaTeX node using \csname verbatiminput\endcsname to render user-readable files into the embedded note image when opened.

items.title: CherryTree through 1.7.3 Denial of Service via Malformed XML Attributes
items.summary: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application through uncaught std::stoi/std::stoll exceptions on malformed XML attributes. Attackers can craft a document with non-numeric or out-of-range char offset, frame width, frame height, col max, or time attributes to repeatedly crash CherryTree and block access to content.

items.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Integer Overflow via OgreBinarySerializer::ReadGeometryVertexBuffer
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer::ReadGeometryVertexBuffer that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted Ogre binary .mesh files. Attackers can supply a large vertex count that wraps the 32-bit size calculation, desynchronising parsing and causing aiScene teardown to delete uninitialised mesh pointers.

items.title: shopizer-ecommerce shopizer authentication.properties hard-coded key
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in shopizer-ecommerce shopizer up to 3.2.5. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file sm-core/src/main/resources/authentication.properties. This manipulation causes use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.title: emailjs 3.2.0 before 5.0.4 Recipient Injection via addressparser Tokenizer
items.summary: emailjs 3.2.0 before 5.0.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that allows attackers to inject hidden recipients by abusing nested comments, semicolons, or backslash escapes. Attackers can craft recipient strings that pass conformant-parser allow lists but make emailjs send RCPT TO commands to attacker-chosen addresses, disclosing message content.

items.title: GPAC before 26.07.0 Path Traversal via httpout Server Filter
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the httpout filter that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read files outside the rdirs root by sending unnormalized request paths. Attackers can send GET or HEAD requests containing ../ or %2e%2e%2f sequences to read configuration files, TLS private keys, or credentials readable by the gpac process.

items.title: Net-SNMP snmpd through 5.9.5.2 and 5.10.pre1 before 5.10.pre3 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via view parse oid()
items.summary: Net-SNMP snmpd through 5.9.5.2 and 5.10.pre1 before 5.10.pre3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in view parse oid() that allows authenticated attackers with SNMP write access to corrupt heap memory. Attackers can send a single SET to vacmViewTreeFamilyTable whose index begins with sub-identifier 4294967295, causing a one-byte write before a malloc(0) allocation and crashing snmpd.

items.title: AVideo before 29.1.0 OS Command Injection via ffmpeg.json.php
items.summary: AVideo before 29.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the ffmpeg.json.php endpoint where notifyCode and callback parameters are concatenated into a shell command without escaping. Attackers who can craft a valid encrypted payload can inject arbitrary shell metacharacters into these fields to execute OS commands as the web-server user.

items.title: AVideo before 29.1.0 OS Command Injection via listFFmpegProcesses
items.summary: AVideo before 29.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in plugin/API/standAlone/functions.php where the listFFmpegProcesses() function interpolates unsanitized keyword parameters inside single quotes without escaping. Attackers who can craft a valid encrypted codeToExec payload can break out of the single-quoted grep context and execute arbitrary OS commands as the web-server user.

items.title: merge-deep-composed before 0.1.6 Prototype Pollution via mergeDeepOne()
items.summary: merge-deep-composed before 0.1.6 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeDeepOne() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying proto keys. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input containing proto as a merge source to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service in Node.js processes.

items.title: cron-parser before 5.10.1 Unbounded Memory Allocation via CronExpressionParser.parse()
items.summary: Cron-parser before 5.10.1 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.
